text:
anna: flagging a private deploy (ap-onprem-07) incident 1:04Z - keystore sidecar started returning 500s for decrypt. customer reported partial downtime.

li: Any recent RBAC or KMS policy changes?

anna: We did a bulk RBAC sync at 20:58 to tighten list/watch on some clusterroles. No KMS change in the repo AFAIK.

tom: I see keystore sidecar logs: 
```
2026-04-05T21:05:11Z keystore-sidecar ERROR decrypt: KMSDisabledException: Key is pending deletion
2026-04-05T21:05:11Z keystore-sidecar WARN falling back to stale unwrapped secret
```

li: KMSDisabledException -> key state changed. Check key rotation/maintenance automation.

anna: infra-bot shows a scheduled key lifecycle job ran at 20:55 and marked key arn:aws:kms:ap:222:key/zz11-22 for scheduled deletion (30d hold) due to rotation policy. That seems wrong for customer-managed key.

tom: how did that automation pick this key? It should only touch keys tagged `auto-rotate:true`. This key has tag `managed:customer`.

li: possible tag propagation bug in the key-cleaner lambda. Someone recently deployed a template change that defaults missing tags to `{auto-rotate:true}`.

anna: also noticed our cluster-audit logs have no entry for the key-cleaner lambda webhook call because audit-policy filters out non-k8s events. We need a trace.

security-bot: CVE-2024-4433 referenced in staff notes but unrelated. Vulnerability triage not needed yet.

tom: immediate actions: (1) cancel scheduled deletion via KMS console/API, (2) rollback key-cleaner lambda change, (3) open incident INC-2026-010, severity P1 for data availability, (4) verify RBAC sync didn't remove keystore SA permissions.

li: I've revoked the scheduled deletion at 21:12Z via `aws kms cancel-key-deletion --key-id zz11-22`. API returned success.

anna: good. RBAC sync check: clusterrolebinding for `keystore-operator` intact, but one ClusterRole lost `secrets/get` on the `ap-onprem-07` namespace due to a selector mismatch. That could explain degraded read paths earlier.

tom: both RBAC and KMS contributed. Postmortem notes: audit pipeline must capture key-cleaner lambda webhook events, and our infra CI must run a gating test that rejects tag defaults impacting customer-managed keys.

li: follow-ups: add an alert when aws kms key state transitions to PendingDeletion for keys with tag `managed:customer` and add an e2e test for RBAC sync generator.

infra-bot: "INC-2026-010 created by anna at 2026-04-05T21:20Z 1:20 assigned: anna, li, tom"

anna: customer confirmed service restored after cancel and RBAC patch at 21:25Z. I'll write blameless post with timeline.

tom: I'll add a k8s audit rule to include controller webhook calls and annotate the key-cleaner webhook with a `component:keystore-cleaner` label to make filtering easier.

li: ack. Closing for now, will track follow-ups in INC-2026-010. :white_check_mark:
